subtitle: Open-source 3D pocket games
promotionalText: More than twenty free 3D games made for handheld consoles, now on your iPhone: the handheld's buttons on your screen, gamepad support, and new games in the store.
description:
PocketVibe is a little game console in your pocket. It started on Linux handhelds and Android, and now brings its games to the iPhone: small, fast 3D games that you play with the buttons of a handheld, drawn right on your screen.

PLAY
- Over twenty games: a jetpack runner, brick breaker, minigolf, a lap racer, pinball, falling blocks, a snake on a toy board, a tower stacker and more.
- Five of them come with the app, and the Store has the rest, one press away. Games update themselves before they start.
- No accounts, no ads, no in-app purchases, no tracking. Everything plays offline once it is downloaded.

MADE FOR YOUR THUMBS
- Hold the phone upright and the game sits on top with a d-pad, A, B, X, Y, L, R, Start and Select below it. Turn it on its side and the buttons move to either side.
- Connect a gamepad and the on-screen buttons make way for it.

OPEN SOURCE
Every game in the store is open source, built from its public code and reviewed before it is published. Anyone can make one: PocketVibe's game template and guide are at pocketvibe.dev. If a game is not right, report it from its page in the app.

review.notes:
PocketVibe is a launcher for small open-source 3D games made with three.js, first built for Linux and Android handheld consoles. No account or login is needed.

HOW TO TRY IT
- The Library starts with five games. Use the on-screen buttons: the d-pad moves, A plays or selects, B goes back, L and R switch between Library, Store and Settings.
- Hold START and SELECT together to leave a game.
- The Store tab lists more games; open one and press A to download it.

GUIDELINE 4.7 (HTML5 MINI GAMES)
- The games are HTML5 and JavaScript, downloaded from our curated store (catalog: https://pocketvibe-store.mertcobanov.workers.dev/catalog.json) and run in WKWebView. They get no native APIs, no permissions and no user data.
- Every game is open source and built from its public code; a maintainer reviews each pull request before it is published: https://github.com/cobanov/pocketvibe-store
- Report: on a game's page press X (More), then Report this game. Reports go to the store's maintainer, who answers within a few days and removes games that break the rules.
- Block: the same menu has Hide games by <author>, which keeps that author's games out of the store; Settings lists hidden authors.
- Age: every game carries an age rating; this app lists only games rated 9+ or lower.
- Index and links: the Store tab lists every game with its details, and each game has a universal link, https://pocketvibe.dev/game/<id>/, that opens it in the app.
- No purchases, no ads, no data collection (https://pocketvibe.dev/privacy/).
